objective: Close a formal-evidence gap left by camera-only CommandBuffer auditing: Built-in Render Pipeline lights can carry their own scheduled CommandBuffers around shadow-map/screenspace-shadow events and could contaminate reflection or final 4K evidence without appearing on the camera.

changes.summary: Added a fail-closed machine-readable contract for sole SummerSun lighting, no active artificial lights, no Light-attached CommandBuffers on any scene Light including disabled lights, pre-cull/pre-render/post-render state stability, actual-render-only visual scoring, and direct pixel review.

Added an InitializeOnLoad formal-frame guard for QA4K_/QAPreparedTemporal_ native 3840x2160 targets. It audits all LightEvent attachment points, cross-checks Light.commandBufferCount, requires exactly one active emitting directional SummerSun bound to RenderSettings.sun, rejects active non-key lights, and SHA-256-locks light/global-shadow/fog/cookie state through the complete camera render lifecycle.

Integrated LightEvidencePurity validation into the existing reflection-lighting-state-v2 request/poll/completion/pre-still fingerprint path, so realtime reflection evidence also fails closed if Light-side injection or contradictory active lighting is present at any observed synchronization boundary.

findings: The canonical environment creates one SummerSun directional light.
The park lamp creates a Point Light with intensity 0, so the new active-artificial-light prohibition does not conflict with the intended daytime benchmark builder state.
Existing CameraEvidencePurity already forbids Camera-attached CommandBuffers but did not cover Light.AddCommandBuffer/GetCommandBuffers.

verification.apiCompatibilityResearch: Unity 6.0 scripting documentation exposes Light.commandBufferCount and Light.GetCommandBuffers, and LightEvent defines shadow/light render insertion points. No Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile claim is made until a Runner is available.
selfAudit: Guard includes disabled Light components in CommandBuffer audit because a callback could enable a preconfigured light later in the frame.
Per-LightEvent counted buffers are cross-checked against Light.commandBufferCount; any nonzero attachment fails closed.
Reflection synchronization now invokes the same purity validation on every existing lighting-fingerprint request/poll/completion/pre-still check.

Formal camera callback hash uses all scene-light active/enabled/type/intensity/color/shadow/transform/cookie state plus global shadow/fog settings, so an observed mid-frame lighting mutation invalidates the frame rather than silently establishing a new baseline.

knownLimitations: Source/GitHub inspection cannot prove the new C# compiles under Unity 6000.3.0f1; the missing Runner remains the blocker.

The guard cannot prove absence of transient Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer calls, native/plugin rendering injection, or a mutation that occurs entirely between all observed callbacks/poll boundaries; actual rendered evidence remains authoritative.
A zero-command-buffer state does not prove lighting quality, shadow quality, reflection quality, or absence of light leaks; it only removes one hidden injection route.
No Visual Fidelity category or critical defect is cleared from this source-side evidence.

implementationReadiness.reasonNoIncrease: The remaining 7 readiness points are reserved for actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification. This run strengthens evidence integrity only.

expectedScoreImpactAfterRealRender: Lighting/shadows/reflections: reduces risk that custom LightEvent shadow or screenspace-mask injection invalidates the physical midsummer lighting evidence.
Material/PBR: keeps realtime reflection cubemaps and final material response from being silently altered through a hidden Light CommandBuffer route.
Cinematic image: prevents undeclared light-side render injection from beautifying or otherwise altering canonical still evidence while the camera itself remains clean.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing: every formal temporal frame must retain the same light/global-shadow state through its render lifecycle; actual shimmer and LOD pop still require pixel review.
Critical inconsistent_sun_shadow_direction and major_light_leak remain actual-pixel decisions; this run only strengthens their evidence provenance.

nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/Editor compile and runtime. When available, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. First verify LightEvidencePurity survives reflection request/polls and every QA4K_/QAPreparedTemporal_ pre-cull/pre-render/post-render callback with zero Light CommandBuffers and only SummerSun emitting, then inspect sealed 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing pixels plus 100% crops before any Visual Fidelity scoring.
